fusions.name: Into the Pen
fusions.desc: Drives forward through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 12 damage, knocking everything caught back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Yoked Blow
fusions.desc: Throws a yoke for 28 damage, up to 1.4 times that at 6 tiles, leaving the target [Leaden] for 6 seconds. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Close Corral
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 9 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Stall-Fed
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
